note: Custom-node packs the pack workflows exercise, keyed by their ComfyUI/custom_nodes directory name and pinned to the commits the frontend's custom-node gate tests (ComfyUI_frontend browser_tests/fixtures/data/customNodeManifest.core.json). Bump a pin by PR: build-image.yml rebuilds the baking images, then re-bless the pack workflows' goldens. `constraints` are extra pins for pack installs on top of the lane's torch pins.

ComfyUI-Impact-Pack.label: Impact-Pack 8.28.3
ComfyUI-Impact-Pack.note: requirements.txt pulls sam2 from its git HEAD; sam2's build needs torch and setuptools from the venv, so it is installed without build isolation, and SAM2_BUILD_CUDA=0 (Dockerfile) skips its CUDA extension. install.py is never run.

ComfyUI-Impact-Subpack.label: Impact-Subpack 1.3.5
ComfyUI-Impact-Subpack.note: Provides UltralyticsDetectorProvider for Impact-Pack; its detector models come from the workflow manifest (models/ultralytics), never from its install.py.

ComfyUI-Manager.label: Manager 4.3
ComfyUI-Manager.note: Manager 4.x is a pip package (not a custom_nodes clone) that ComfyUI loads with --enable-manager. The config keeps its startup hermetic: no node-database fetch from GitHub, no log file under user/.
